data.one_liner: Official VK ID SDK for user authentication and authorization in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides OAuth 2.1 authorization, one-tap login buttons using VK, Mail, and OK accounts, popups, and access to user data for Android and iOS.
use_when: You need user authentication via VK ID in your Flutter app.
You want to use official VK one-tap login elements or custom auth buttons.
avoid_when: You do not need VK integration and are looking for other auth providers like Google or Apple only.
Your project uses Flutter versions older than 3.10.6.
strengths: Comprehensive library supporting OAuth 2.1, popups, and multibranding.
Supports Android and iOS native SDK under the hood.
weaknesses: Requires specific newer versions of Flutter, Android SDK, Java, Kotlin, Swift, and Xcode.
Platform-specific configuration required for both Android and iOS credentials.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android SDK 21+, Java 11+, Kotlin 2.0.20+, iOS 12.0+, Swift 5.9+, Xcode 15.2+, and setting up client credentials in native config files.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Google account sign-in instead of VK.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Apple ID sign-in instead of VK.
